quests.title: Thief-Catcher

dialogue.t: Hmph, these Treasure Hoarders... What a persistent pack of rats they are.
You're back. Have you wiped their camps out yet?
As I thought, it was child's play for you, Honorary Knight.
I will admit that these Treasure Hoarders are quite persistent. Everyone was running for cover during the storm. They, by contrast, had the daring to run out and steal things.
If only they had used that perseverance for something proper instead...

quests.description: The storm has just ended, and Cyrus from the Adventurers’ Guild is currently planning to clear the Treasure Hoarders out…
